title: the American Indian mythos
audit_comment: THE AMERICAN INDIAN MYTHOS - the D&DG walk round two, print pp. 12-16: fourteen beings (Raven, Coyote, Hastsezini, Hastseltsi, Heng, Hiawatha, Hotoru, Qagwaaz, Shakak, Snake-Man, Stoneribs, the Thunder Bird, Yanauluha, Tobadzistsini), the pantheon-wide cleric doctrine, and the sacred bundle. Zero registry defs touched; the floor holds at 995. The flagged eyeball cells: Hastsezini CH -1 and Shakak CH 6.

banner.title: the American Indian mythos - the D&DG walk round two, print pp. 12-16: the North American pantheon, fourteen beings from the Raven to Tobadzistsini, the pantheon doctrine and the sacred bundle.
banner.provenance: primary ink: the extract/ddg tesseract pass (commit cd645b4, pNNN_full.txt + pNNN_tsv.tsv, print = pdf - 1, pages 013-017); the four-voice collation adjudications (the TSV word geometry and the archive.org 1st-print derivative): Heng, Hotoru and Yanauluha attacks printed 3/2 (the 47-48px three-glyph width matches the known-good Qagwaaz/Stoneribs 3/2, against the Termux dropped-glyph 3.2), Coyote psionic class III and Hastsezini II (the IA geometry 47px), Hastsezini CH -1 (both voices read CH:-], five glyphs, the horror-table doctrine), Shakak CH 6 (both voices, four glyphs), the Thunder Bird X/22,600 xp line (both voices), and Stoneribs size 5 and one half feet (66 inches).
banner.sentinel: the 0 sentinels: MoveAlt 0 = a single printed move; AtD 0 = a single printed attacks figure; the magic resistance 0 = the printed Standard (Hiawatha, Qagwaaz, Stoneribs); the ability-grid Thunder Bird row is all 0 (the monster-format being prints no ability line); the class-grid 0 = Nil or none printed (Hastsezini magic-user 0 = the printed See below - the 30th-level fire spells ride the consts); roster Plane 0 = none printed (the heroes), worship 0 = none printed, lair percent 0 = none printed, XP 0 = none printed (the Thunder Bird row carries 22600).
